scope: Construct and measure tags from the earlier AI-assisted landscape scan. Counts describe linked references in this collection, not independent studies, evidence quality, risk or field-wide coverage.

areas.label: Skills & decision-making
areas.description: Learning, task performance and how people judge advice.

facets.label: Learning
facets.description: Acquiring knowledge or learning a new task.

facets.label: Skills
facets.description: Ability to carry out a task; the tag alone does not establish long-term skill change.

facets.label: Expert judgement
facets.description: Knowledge and judgement developed through domain experience.

facets.label: Memory & offloading
facets.description: Remembering information and using tools to perform mental work.

facets.label: Critical thinking
facets.description: Reflection, checking reasoning and judging one's own knowledge.

facets.label: Decision quality
facets.description: The quality or accuracy of decisions in the studied setting.

facets.label: Reliance on advice
facets.description: When people accept or reject AI advice, including over- and under-reliance.

facets.label: Creativity & diversity
facets.description: Creative output and diversity of ideas; individual quality and group diversity are different outcomes.

areas.label: Agency & autonomy
areas.description: People's choices, sense of agency and practical control.

facets.label: Autonomy & choice
facets.description: Research tagged as autonomy; this broad tag does not establish actual freedom of choice or control.

facets.label: Sense of agency
facets.description: Feeling responsible for, or in control of, one's actions and work.

facets.label: Beliefs & attitudes
facets.description: Persuasion, belief change and attitude formation; change alone does not establish reduced autonomy.

facets.label: Trust
facets.description: Trust in AI and its advice; trust is not a direct measure of control.

facets.label: Dependence
facets.description: Habitual or psychological reliance on a system.

facets.label: Confidence in ability
facets.description: People's belief in their ability to act or perform a task.

facets.label: Oversight & control
facets.description: Human review, intervention and authority over AI-assisted decisions.

facets.label: Reliance on advice
facets.description: When people accept or reject AI advice, including over- and under-reliance.

columns.label: Behavioural tasks
columns.description: Observed choices or behaviour in a task.

columns.label: Performance without AI
columns.description: Performance assessed without AI; this tag does not establish prior AI exposure, delayed retention or recovery.

columns.label: Logs & records
columns.description: Interaction logs, administrative or operational records.

columns.label: Model evaluations
columns.description: Tests of model behaviour; these do not by themselves establish effects on people.

columns.label: Physiological measures
columns.description: Neural or physiological recordings, whose interpretation depends on the specific study.
